justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/bytecode/StackManipulation.java and byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/bytecode/StackSize.java. `StackManipulation.Size` is a small nested value object with only two ints plus `ZERO`, `aggregate(...)`, and getters, so its outgoing coupling is low. It does have broad fan-in: `rg` found 92 source/test files referencing `StackManipulation.Size` or constructors/related stack-size helpers, but the class itself does not depend on many other classes, so the hub-like modularization smell is not present.
